sentence: This project builds a probe for robotic surgical systems that senses tumor location and boundaries.
This project studies how data biases affect the fairness of decisions made by machine learning algorithms.
This project builds a design framework that uses machine learning to find 2D metal halide perovskites that resist fracture.
This project builds a community resource with datasets and tools for studying audio deepfakes in English.
This project develops a way to separate vapor from liquid on slippery surfaces to improve condensation heat transfer.
This project studies how a small molecule called a microRNA controls color and camouflage patterns in a moth caterpillar.
This project studies how space shapes the way populations change over time, using mathematical models on a graph.
This project builds a tool that measures chemical properties of liquids by how flowing microdroplets diffract light.
This project studies how landscape changes affect movement and gene flow in six species of non-human primates.
This project studies how crickets, katydids and their relatives evolved the ability to hear and sing.
This project tests whether an mRNA lipid nanoparticle can make tumor cells more vulnerable to chemotherapy.
This project sets up a network of conservation research on ecosystems such as rainforests, mangroves, coral reefs and seagrass beds.
This project builds a modeling framework to test how well in-memory computing designs handle real application workloads.
This project creates algorithms that find a path to a goal that is described only by its properties.
This project builds a machine learning method that predicts cancer patient survival using molecular data and biological knowledge.
This project builds small bipedal, multilegged and wheeled robots by studying how actuation, mechanics and contact forces change with size.
